channel.title: Forensics: The Real CSI
channel.desc: At midday on a busy high street in Birmingham, a group of armed robbers drive a truck into a jewellery shop, stealing ?300,000 worth of gold. They escape in less than 60 seconds. Forensic scene investigator Drew Birtles is dispatched to the jewellery shop to recover any forensic clues which could help identify the robbers. The investigation becomes more challenging when no real forensic evidence is found at the crime scene and the robbers switch cars, leaving the trail to go cold.
